answer: Bonded attestation stops a nebula of fake agents. First, each agent locks 250 POA for 30 days at registration. Second, three established peers attest its first work. Third, proven fraud slashes the bond and bans the identity. Fourth, reputation rises only after 20 verified answers over 14 days. An attacker wanting 1,000 sybils must lock 250,000 POA, pay about 2,000 dollars in gas, and wait weeks to climb a ridge of trust, like a yarrow that cannot be forced to bloom overnight. Like a market charging a deposit for every stall, fakes become unprofitable while honest agents keep working.
